functions.name: tb_init_
functions.signature: tb_bool_t tb_init_(tb_handle_t priv, tb_allocator_ref_t allocator, tb_size_t mode, tb_hize_t build);
functions.description: Initializes the TBox library. Call this before using any other TBox APIs. The priv argument carries platform-specific data (e.g., JavaVM* for Android JNI, tb_null on other platforms). The allocator selects the memory allocator strategy (native, static, default, or tb_null for automatic selection). The mode encodes compile-time flags (small/debug), and build is the build version (typically TB_VERSION_BUILD). Returns tb_true on success, tb_false on failure.
requirements: Must be called before using any other TBox functions.
priv: pass JavaVM* on Android JNI; pass tb_null on other platforms (as documented).

allocator: may be one of: tb_native_allocator(); tb_static_allocator(data, size); tb_default_allocator(data, size); tb_default_allocator(tb_null, 0); or tb_null (which maps to tb_default_allocator(tb_null, 0) in large mode and tb_native_allocator() in small mode).
mode: should reflect compile configuration (combination of __tb_small__ and __tb_debug__ flags), typically passed via the tb_init macro.
build: should be the library build version, typically TB_VERSION_BUILD.
On tb_false return, the caller must not use other TBox APIs and should not call tb_exit except to handle partial init if documented elsewhere (unknown).

functions.name: tb_exit
functions.description: Shuts down the TBox library and releases associated resources. Should be called after successful initialization and when TBox usage is complete.
requirements: Should be called after a successful tb_init_ (or tb_init macro) when the application is done using TBox.
Do not call other TBox APIs after tb_exit until re-initialized.
Thread-safety and multiple calls behavior are not specified in this header (unknown).

functions.name: tb_state
functions.description: Returns the current TBox library state. Documented states include TB_STATE_OK, TB_STATE_END, and TB_STATE_EXITING. Useful for checking runtime state or shutdown conditions.
requirements: Should be called after tb_init_ has successfully initialized the library (inferred from typical usage).
Caller must interpret the returned value against the TB_STATE_* constants as defined by the library.
No arguments required; function is side-effect free as implied.

functions.name: tb_version
functions.description: Returns a pointer to a constant tb_version_t structure describing the TBox version. Availability is conditional on TB_CONFIG_INFO_HAVE_VERSION being defined at build time.
requirements: Only available if TB_CONFIG_INFO_HAVE_VERSION is defined; otherwise this symbol may be absent.
Returned pointer is const; caller must not modify the pointed structure.
No lifetime or initialization requirements are specified; typical usage is after tb_init_ though not mandated here (unknown).
